title: Scaffold a Mod smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Scaffold a Mod craftbook: a craft-a-boat-get-a-diamond datapack for Minecraft 1.21 — pack.mcmeta with the format number from the house version notes, singular 1.21 folder names under a namespace, one working example, and a README a kid can follow.
prompt: my kid wants a datapack that gives you a diamond when you craft a boat — can you scafold it for 1.21?

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for mod-scaffold. The target is a Minecraft 1.21 datapack; the house version notes at notes/format-versions.md carry the pack_format table (1.21 uses 48) and the 1.21 singular folder-name rule. pack.mcmeta goes at the workspace root, the namespaced content under data/, and the install guide in README.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Scaffold a Mod craftbook/template, lock the 1.21 structure rules from the version notes, build the datapack tree with one working example of the boat-diamond idea, and write README.md with install and test steps. No game launches or external tools — the scaffold and docs are the deliverable.

files.content:
# Datapack format numbers (house notes)

| Game version | pack_format |
| --- | --- |
| 1.20 | 15 |
| 1.20.6 | 41 |
| 1.21 | 48 |
| 1.21.5 | 71 |

Folder names: since 1.21 the data folder names are singular - function,
recipe, advancement, loot_table, and tags/function. Before 1.21 they were
plural - functions, recipes, advancements, loot_tables, tags/functions.
A pack using the old plural names loads on 1.21+ but its content silently
never fires.

success.summary: pack.mcmeta declares pack_format 48 per the version notes, the namespaced tree under data/ carries a working boat-diamond example in at least three content files, and README.md gives concrete install and test steps naming 1.21.

checks.label: pack_format matches the 1.21 value from the version notes
the test step exercises the mod idea

checks.rubric: The install steps are concrete enough for a twelve-year-old (where the folder goes, one action per step) and the test step says exactly what to do in-game and what should happen. The version note warns that other versions may need a different format number.
checks.label: kid-followable docs

axes.name: structure-correctness
axes.description: The tree uses the 1.21 singular folder names under a proper namespace; every file the example needs exists.

axes.name: version-awareness
axes.description: pack_format and folder layout come from the version notes, not memory.

axes.name: docs-clarity
axes.description: Install and test steps work for a kid with no prior modding.

axes.name: idea-fit
axes.description: The working example actually implements craft-a-boat-get-a-diamond.
